_what: Every deploy gate in scripts/check-*.mjs, and WHEN it runs. This file is the single source of truth: scripts/ship.mjs runs the gates by reading this manifest, so a gate listed here cannot fail to be invoked, and scripts/check-gates-wired.mjs fails the deploy if any check-*.mjs on disk is missing from this manifest. Adding a gate file is therefore enough to have it enforced; forgetting to wire it is no longer possible.

_phases.pre: Runs before deploy, blocking. Local checks and anything that must stop a bad value from shipping at all.
_phases.post: Runs after promotion, blocking. Needs the live site to answer, so it can only be judged once the new build is serving.
_phases.exempt: Deliberately not run by ship. Requires a reason field. Use sparingly.

_inline: invoked_inline: true means ship.mjs calls this gate by name at a specific point because it needs special env or ordering. check-gates-wired.mjs verifies the literal filename still appears in ship.mjs, so deleting that call is caught.

check-widget-contrast.mjs.note: authored 2026-08-06 and left out of this manifest, so it would never have run — the same defect as CODING_LAW, whose gate was written and unwired for a day

check-gates-wired.mjs.note: the meta-gate: every gate on disk is in this manifest

check-coding-law.mjs.note: a hash to start, a hash to commit — no changed code file ships without a committed lease matching its contents

check-inline-recursive-content.mjs.note: blocks deployment unless the ordinary article surface supports the complete visible block editing contract

check-article-ledger.mjs.note: every article renders the model comment thread and the keyless mint call; probes oldest and newest live

check-approval-tokens.mjs.note: no self-issued approval: a shipping commit carrying #vault-approved / #widgets-approved fails the deploy, and the protection lists may not shrink

check-vault-download.mjs.note: needs the live site: the whole corpus must be reachable through the paged export, ?all in every spelling must mean the same corpus, and format=zip must be a real archive

check-comment-hygiene.mjs.note: needs the live corpus: pins the detector to the probe bodies that shipped on /a/semaglutide and /a/tirzepatide, and refuses any new probe rendered on a public thread

check-law-enforcement.mjs.note: every clause in every law object declares a named check or a written reason it cannot have one; the undeclared count and the open redundancy groups are ratcheted in law-enforcement-baseline.json and may only fall

check-migration-selection.mjs.note: WF-0005: proves ship selects a real new migration over the 9999 reseed sentinel regardless of checkout mtimes; blocks the deploy if the selector could misfire

check-automation-wall-clock.mjs.note: a job with a time of day fires at that hour in Pacific, once per local day, and never also on an interval

check-execution-case-law.mjs.note: WF-0006 repair: task-bound counts, decision completeness, candidate→receipt binding and the reviewed-send gate must hold before anything ships

check-registry-matches-git.mjs.note: needs TERMINAL_KEY and the git history: proves every recent registry head is content that actually landed, so the staleness signal keeps meaning something

check-served-script-parses.mjs.note: needs TERMINAL_KEY and the live site: parses the inline JavaScript the browser is actually served, because a template literal eats single backslashes on the way out and node --check on the source cannot see it
